content_sections.heading: Visakhapatnam Port Authority Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Important Dates
content_sections.text: Eligible candidates must register on the NAPS portal and apply for the Visakhapatnam Port Authority trade opportunity by 3 December 2026.

content_sections.heading: Visakhapatnam Port Authority Apprentice Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: The Visakhapatnam Port Authority has announced 20 Trade Apprentice placements across five designated ITI trades. Each trade has four training positions. Reservation for Scheduled Caste, Scheduled Tribe and Other Backward Class candidates will be implemented according to the applicable provisions of the Apprentices Act, 1961.

content_sections.heading: Visakhapatnam Port Authority Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: The Mechanical & Electrical Engineering Department of Visakhapatnam Port Authority has issued a notification in November 2026 for the engagement of 20 Trade Apprentices under the Apprentices Act, 1961. The two-page notification provides trade-wise placements, qualification requirements, stipend, minimum age, selection criteria, employee preference rules and application instructions. Official Application Portal: NAPS Apprenticeship India Notification PDF: Direct permanent VPA-hosted PDF link pending verification.

content_sections.heading: Visakhapatnam Port Authority Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates must have passed ITI in the relevant designated trade and completed a minimum age of 14 years as on 3 December 2026. Important: Candidates must possess the specific ITI qualification prescribed for the selected trade. Selection will be based on aggregate marks secured in the ITI qualifying examination.

rows.essential_qualification: ITI Pass in Mechanic (Motor Vehicle) Trade
ITI Pass in Electronics Mechanic Trade

content_sections.heading: Visakhapatnam Port Authority Apprentice Age Limit 2026
content_sections.text: Applicants should have completed a minimum of 14 years of age as on 3 December 2026 . The notification does not prescribe a separate maximum age or category-wise age relaxation table. Candidates must follow the applicable apprenticeship rules and official portal requirements.

content_sections.heading: Visakhapatnam Port Authority Apprentice Stipend 2026
content_sections.text: Selected apprentices will receive a monthly stipend between Rs. 8,344.60 and Rs. 9,387.67 , depending on the trade. Stipend Clarification: These are apprenticeship stipends payable during the one-year training period, not regular employee salary scales.

content_sections.heading: Visakhapatnam Port Authority Apprentice Training Duration 2026
content_sections.text: All five designated trades have a training duration of one year under the Apprentices Act, 1961. Visakhapatnam Port Authority states that it is not liable to provide employment to applicants or apprentices after completion of their training.

content_sections.heading: Visakhapatnam Port Authority Apprentice Application Fee 2026
content_sections.text: The uploaded recruitment notification does not specify an application fee or fee-payment procedure. Candidates should follow the instructions on the official Apprenticeship India portal. No unverified application fee should be assumed.

content_sections.heading: Visakhapatnam Port Authority Apprentice Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: Selection will be based on aggregate marks obtained in the relevant ITI examination , followed by certificate verification. Online Application: Candidates submit their applications through the NAPS apprenticeship portal. Merit-Based Shortlisting: Applications are evaluated based on aggregate marks obtained in the qualifying ITI examination. Preference Criteria: The prescribed preference arrangement for eligible children of port employees will apply. Certificate Verification: Shortlisted candidates will be called for verification of original certificates. Trade Allotment: The Head of the Department will allot trades at their discretion. Apprenticeship Engagement: Selected candidates will undergo one year of training, subject to applicable engagement formalities. The notification provides preference for eligible children of employees in the ratio of 4:1:1 . Within the portion allotted to children of VPA employees, a further 2:1:1 preference arrangement applies. Candidates claiming employee-related preference must satisfy the applicable documentary requirements. The notification calls for verification of supporting employee records and certification by the concerned Section Officer. No separate written examination is specified in the notification. Apprentice engagement is based on ITI aggregate marks and certificate verification, subject to the prescribed preference rules.

content_sections.heading: Visakhapatnam Port Authority Apprentice Apply Online 2026
content_sections.text: Eligible candidates can apply for the 20 Trade Apprentice positions through the National Apprenticeship Promotion Scheme (NAPS) portal from 4 November to 3 December 2026 . Apply Online: Apprenticeship India Official Portal Establishment Name: Visakhapatnam Port Authority Application Last Date: 3 December 2026. Candidates must register on the NAPS portal and then apply for the relevant opportunity under the Visakhapatnam Port Authority establishment. Merely registering on the portal is not the same as applying for the specific apprenticeship opportunity.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply Online for Visakhapatnam Port Authority Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
content_sections.text: Visit the official Apprenticeship India website at www.apprenticeshipindia.gov.in . Register as a candidate on the NAPS Apprentice portal if not already registered. Log in using the registered credentials. Navigate to the Find an Apprentice Opportunity section. Click the option to search available apprenticeship opportunities. Select the relevant ITI trade. Select the course type as Designated . Choose Andhra Pradesh as the location. Search for the establishment name Visakhapatnam Port Authority . Select the applicable apprenticeship opportunity. Click the Apply option. Complete the application process according to the portal instructions. Submit the application by 3 December 2026 . Keep the registration and application details for future communication. Important: Candidates must apply to the correct establishment and trade. The notification specifies that the final trade allotment will be at the discretion of the Head of the Department.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required for Visakhapatnam Port Authority Apprentice Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: The notification confirms that shortlisted applicants will be called for certificate verification. It does not provide a complete general document-upload checklist. Candidates should keep their relevant ITI qualification certificate, ITI marksheets, age proof and documents supporting any claimed employee-related preference ready. Original documents and other certificates must be produced as instructed during verification. Applicants claiming preference as children of VPA employees must comply with the certification requirements specified by the concerned department.

content_sections.heading: Visakhapatnam Port Authority Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The notification announces 20 Trade Apprentice placements. There are four placements each in five designated ITI trades. Online applications start on 4 November 2026. The last date to apply is 3 December 2026. Candidates must have passed ITI in the relevant trade. The minimum age is 14 years as on 3 December 2026. All trades have a one-year training duration. Selection is based on aggregate ITI marks. Preference applies to eligible children of port employees under the notified ratio. Only shortlisted candidates will be called for certificate verification. The Head of the Department has discretion in trade allotment. VPA will not pay TA/DA for attending certificate verification. No boarding or lodging expenses are admissible. Completion of apprenticeship does not guarantee employment with VPA.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by Visakhapatnam Port Authority (VPA) for engaging Trade Apprentices under the Apprenticeship Act, 1961 for multiple trades.

faq.question: Q2. How many total vacancies are available in VPA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 20 vacancies available for various Trade Apprentice posts distributed equally across Welder, Electrician, Fitter, Motor Mechanic, and Electronics Mechanic trades.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for VPA Trade Apprentice?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed ITI in the relevant trade from a recognized institute to be eligible for applying to the respective trade apprentice positions.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for applying to these posts?
faq.answer: Candidates must have completed a minimum of 14 years of age as on 03 December 2026 to be eligible for the apprenticeship training program.

faq.question: Q5. What is the last date to apply online?
faq.answer: The online application process closes on 03 December 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well before the final deadline.

faq.question: Q6. How will candidates be selected for the Trade Apprentice positions?
faq.answer: Selection is carried out purely on a merit basis, calculated from the aggregate marks obtained by applicants in their respective ITI examinations.

faq.question: Q7. What is the monthly stipend provided during the apprenticeship?
faq.answer: Selected apprentices will receive a monthly stipend ranging from Rs. 8,344.60 to Rs. 9,387.67 depending on the trade they are enrolled in.

faq.question: Q8. Through which portal should candidates submit their applications?
faq.answer: Candidates must submit their online applications through the official NAPS Apprentice portal located at https://www.apprenticeshipindia.gov.in.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any application fee for VPA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No application fee has been prescribed or mentioned in the official notification released by the Visakhapatnam Port Authority.

faq.question: Q10. Will VPA provide permanent employment after the apprenticeship?
faq.answer: No, VPA is not liable to provide any regular employment to candidates upon successful completion of their one-year apprenticeship training.
